specific_prose_corrections: The direction variable takes ±1, while |m| describes agreement without its sign. Fixed draws bridge independent updates to conditional mean and variance; averaging order and each retained-index count are explicit.

The deterministic reference replaces each random update by its conditional expectation. It is not claimed to equal the unconditional finite-ensemble mean, and beta=1 is distinguished from a proved infinite-size phase boundary.

Cascade rounds name new failures, cumulative sets and direct damage separately. The triggering formula excludes earlier failed nodes, compares the previous cumulative set synchronously, and preserves failed-neighbor influence when evaluating failure.
A chain and a star with equal nodes and edges are compared under the same seed and thresholds. Largest surviving connectivity is a functional proxy rather than proof of sufficient capacity.

Local rate, its time unit, the unstable positive equilibrium and the nonnegative basin [0,B) are established before comparing finite perturbations. Same linear rate does not assert identical finite perturbation trajectories.

AR(1) innovation assumptions, sampling time, stationary variance and physical lag are explained. Window variance uses its descriptive divisor; the two Pearson segments have separate centers and constant segments make correlation undefined.

The alert example defines a pre-event detection interval and post-alert false-positive interval. Repeated times count once; detected and missed objects are events while false-positive objects are alerts, and counts are not rates.

Two explicit four-cell rings with equal density have different distance-two joint frequencies and next density. The exact one-step relation p_next=2p-2c2 is not a complete multi-step closure or recovery of individual positions.

Three source-specific contrasts share one reference, measure and unit. A multiplicative hand example demonstrates nonadditive joint change. Two scale comparisons show a ranking reversal; no absent parameter-range scan is reported as executed.

The capstone describes its actual five finite repetitions, 36 retained samples, four-node chain, recovery endpoint normalized by B=2 and coarse A-minus-B score. These are distinct metrics rather than a general composite resilience score.

Final option review clarified two parallel averages, the old-neighbor XOR rule and the exact stated interval bound, and replaced cumulative people count by failed-node count. Correct answers, identities, versions and grading data are unchanged.
The three web views preserve all numerical functions and controls while explaining actual lengths, parameters, threshold rounds and sampling units in display text.
